shootDescription: A one-day studio session to produce about 100 distinct marketing photos of Lucky Luke Magic for the website, brochures, social media, advertising, and press kits. The whole shoot is on clean white seamless so every image can be cut out to a transparent background later; brand colors (teal, soft pink, gold, burgundy, charcoal) come from props or are added behind the cutouts in design. Luke wears his current stage outfit throughout: a colorful patterned/floral long-sleeve dress shirt, a dark charcoal/black textured (subtly sparkly) vest, a purple bow tie, dark plaid/tartan trousers, and dark dress shoes, with no suit jacket. White background rules: light the paper separately and evenly so it blows out to pure white at one consistent exposure; keep Luke 8+ ft off the paper so there are no shadows or color spill; use a rim/hair light to separate the beard and graying hair from the white. The colorful shirt and dark vest give strong edge contrast against white; give white props (signs, whiteboard, rope, jumbo card) a defined edge. Most images show Luke alone, built around his face, gestures, and comic timing, with a small number of magic-prop, absurd-comedy, and child-volunteer setups. Must-have images are front-loaded so the shoot succeeds even if time runs short.
